html.a_turn_server_relays_your_audio_whe: A TURN server relays your audio when a firewall blocks a direct peer-to-peer connection. Get a free pair from metered.ca → TURN Server (an app-name subdomain and an API key).
html.for_a_camera_that_does_not_move_dur: For a camera that does not move. During a call, open the background menu on your own video and choose Capture empty room: a countdown gives you time to step out of the picture, and a click tells you when you can come back. The cut-out is then checked against that picture, which sharpens the edge around hair and shoulders — as long as the camera stays where it was. The picture stays in memory on this device, is never sent or saved, and is forgotten when you switch this off. It is set aside on its own if the camera moves or the light changes.
html.how_an_animated_scene_is_lit_match_: How an animated scene is lit. Match my room lights it like the light your camera sees on you, so a dim room gets an evening with the lamps on. A time of day, the clock or your screen’s light or dark mode keeps it that way whatever your room. People who draw your scene themselves see the same light.
html.how_far_the_blur_reaches_as_a_share: How far the blur reaches, as a share of the picture — so it looks the same whatever your camera's resolution. Applies while the background is set to Blur, and takes effect immediately, even mid-call.

How far the blur reaches, as a share of the picture — so it looks the same whatever your camera's resolution. Applies while the background is set to Blur, and reaches the main window immediately, even mid-call.
html.how_often_you_are_picked_out_of_the: How often you are picked out of the picture again. High follows fast movement more closely and costs more battery; Battery does the opposite. A device that cannot keep up is stepped down on its own whatever you choose here.
html.the_host_has_enabled_debug_mode_whi: The host has enabled debug mode, which can collect some information about your device — such as your system, OS, network connection, time zone or battery level. Nothing is transmitted until you accept.
html.this_push_to_talk_app_and_the_voxal: This push-to-talk app and the voxal.app portal are two parts of one product. The app works fully on its own. The portal is optional: connect your account with Connect to see your organization's channels and who is in them, join a channel in one tap, and use your organization's relay for firewalled networks. The app does the talking; the portal knows who is around.

ui.0_ms_leaves_it_to_the_browser_while_d: 0 ms leaves it to the browser. While Dev mode is on and you are the room host, this value is also pushed to everyone in the room (peers who set their own value keep theirs).
ui.blur_what_is_behind_you_or_replace_it: Blur what is behind you, or replace it. Applies to your camera only, and you are picked out of the picture on this device — no frame is ever sent to a server to do it.
ui.camera_and_screen_share_video_can_rou: Camera and screen-share video can route directly between participants (peer-to-peer) or, for large rooms, through Cloudflare's relay servers, which forward — and can technically see — the video. This never applies to voice, which always stays peer-to-peer.
ui.captures_your_camera_at_1080p_draws_t: Captures your camera at 1080p, draws the background at that size and sends it that way: sharper for you and for everyone you call, at the price of more work on this computer and about four times the upload per person. Restarts your camera when switched. A computer that cannot keep up is stepped down on its own.

ui.hold_the_mic_button_or_your_shortcut_: Hold the mic button (or your shortcut on desktop) to talk, or double-tap for hands-free.
ui.how_hard_the_cut_out_between_you_and_: How hard the cut-out between you and your background is. Softer hides the odd stray pixel and suits hair, glasses and a cluttered room; sharper keeps a crisp outline and suits a plain wall. Applies to the blur and to background images alike, immediately, even mid-call.

ui.how_much_data_voxal_is_moving_right_n: How much data Voxal is moving right now, and what it is carrying. Only meaningful during a call.
How much data Voxal is moving right now, and what it is carrying. Measured in the main window — this one has no connections of its own — so it only shows numbers while a call is live there.
ui.how_much_incoming_audio_to_buffer_bef: How much incoming audio to buffer before playing it. Higher values smooth out choppy audio on a lossy or relayed connection, at the cost of a little delay. Automatic raises it on its own when a link starts dropping packets.
ui.in_a_dim_or_backlit_room_brightens_th: In a dim or backlit room, brightens the copy of the picture the detector looks at — never the picture anyone else sees — so it can still find your outline. Does nothing at all in ordinary light.
ui.let_the_host_see_this_device_s_diagno: Let the host see this device's diagnostics (type, OS, audio, network) while debugging
ui.macos_windows_and_linux_with_a_global: : macOS, Windows and Linux, with a global push-to-talk shortcut
ui.move_the_background_with_my_phone: Move the background with my phone
ui.nothing_is_captured_or_sent_unless_yo: Nothing is captured or sent unless you allow it.
ui.offer_the_camera_and_screen_share_con: Offer the camera and screen-share controls in the room
ui.overlay_the_window_screen_and_safe_ar: Overlay the window, screen and safe-area measurements in a room (diagnoses layout gaps on iOS)
ui.sends_your_voice_out_over_the_network: Sends your voice out over the network and back through a relay, then replays what came back — so you hear what others actually hear, not just your raw microphone.
Sends your voice out over the network and back through a relay, then replays what came back — so you hear what others actually hear, not just your raw microphone. Runs in the main Voxal window.
ui.share_device_info_in_dev_mode: Share device info in dev mode
ui.sharing_stops_automatically_after_10_: Sharing stops automatically after 10 minutes, or whenever you press Stop.
ui.show_dev_log_panel_peer_uuids_and_deb: Show dev log panel, peer UUIDs, and debug labels
ui.show_how_to_stop_your_browser_asking_: Show how to stop your browser asking for the microphone on every visit
ui.show_peer_uuids_copy_buttons_and_host: Show peer UUIDs, copy buttons, and Host/Deputy labels
ui.shown_in_the_room_once_your_browser_h: Shown in the room once your browser has asked for the microphone on two separate visits — it cannot remember the grant for you, so the tip names the setting that makes it stick.
ui.shown_to_other_people_in_rooms: Shown to other people in rooms.
ui.speaker: Speaker
ui.the_chosen_scene_on_its_own_drawn_on_: The chosen scene on its own, drawn on this device. Drag it, or swipe on a phone, to look around the room (in a call you can do the same on your own picture). The full-screen button at its bottom right shows it over the whole screen, at its own shape, with the scenes and the light at the top right.
ui.the_host_helps_everyone_find_each_oth: The host helps everyone find each other, and if the host leaves, another participant takes over so the room stays alive.
ui.the_room_code_is_the_host: The room code is the host.
ui.turns_the_camera_and_screen_buttons_o: Turns the Camera and Screen buttons on in the room. Your camera stays off until you switch it on yourself — this only decides whether the controls are offered.
ui.used_only_when_no_credentials_are_set: Used only when no credentials are set above, so peers behind strict firewalls can still connect.
ui.voices_travel_directly_between_partic: Voices travel directly between participants over WebRTC. Audio never goes through a media server.
ui.voxal_is_an_instant_push_to_talk_voic: Voxal is an instant push-to-talk voice room. Create a room, share its code or link, and anyone who joins can talk to the others, like a walkie-talkie. Camera, screen sharing and chat are there when you want them. No account is needed.
ui.when_a_direct_path_is_blocked_an_encr: When a direct path is blocked, an encrypted relay forwards the traffic without being able to hear it.
ui.when_a_room_host_has_dev_mode_on_an_i: When a room host has dev mode on, an “i” button appears next to each name showing device, audio & network diagnostics. This is off until you accept — nothing is shared otherwise.
ui.which_side_the_talk_button_sits_on_in: Which side the talk button sits on in landscape (web).
ui.with_an_animated_scene_sends_just_you: With an animated scene, sends just you and a thin edge of your room; the people you call draw the same scene on their own device. Uses less upload in calls that go peer to peer. They may see the scene slightly differently, and it costs their device some work. Has no effect with blur or your own image, or when video goes through the relay.
ui.with_an_animated_scene_the_room_behin: With an animated scene, the room behind you turns as you tilt or turn your phone, the way a real one would. Uses the phone's motion sensor; nothing is recorded or sent anywhere except the angle itself, to people who draw your scene.
ui.works_when_app_is_focused_only: · works when app is focused only
ui.you_can_change_this_anytime_in_settin: You can change this anytime in Settings → Advanced.
